title: Unrecognized and unauthorized transactions - support procedure
content: This is a high-priority handoff. The demo agent receives the masked description, amount and known channel, and may simulate blocking a verified synthetic card. Do not share credentials, and use your real bank's verified fraud contact for actual losses.
